title: Discount Code
description: A code a buyer types at the cart. The site works out the amount; the cart stores only the code.
formgrid:
active type
id title
value minSubtotal
products products
categories categories
startsAt endsAt
usageLimit perCustomerLimit
recurring usedCount

id.label: Code
id.help: Letters, numbers and hyphens, 3 to 40 characters. Buyers can type it in any case.

title.label: Internal Name
title.help: For staff. Never shown to buyers.

active.label: Active
active.help: Turn off to stop the code working without deleting it.

value.label: Value
value.help: Percent off: 15 means 15%. Amount off: an amount in the store currency. Ignored for free shipping.

products.label: Only These Products
products.help: Product ids. Leave this and the categories empty for the whole cart.

categories.label: Only These Categories
categories.help: Product categories the code applies to.

minSubtotal.label: Minimum Subtotal
minSubtotal.help: The cart must reach this amount for the code to work.

startsAt.label: Starts
startsAt.help: The code does not work before this. Leave empty to start now.

endsAt.label: Ends
endsAt.help: The code stops working after this. Leave empty for no end.

usageLimit.label: Total Uses
usageLimit.help: How many orders can use the code. 0 means no limit.

perCustomerLimit.label: Uses per Customer
perCustomerLimit.help: 0 means no limit. Counted by the order's email address.

recurring.label: On a Subscription
recurring.help: Whether the discount repeats on renewals.

usedCount.label: Times Used
usedCount.help: Counted by the site as orders are paid.
